Stop._comment: CRG auto-update after AI turn — PID-guarded, no pile-up

hooks.command: command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d .code-review-graph ] && [ ! -f /tmp/crg-updating.pid ] && { echo $$ > /tmp/crg-updating.pid; code-review-graph update --skip-flows; rm -f /tmp/crg-updating.pid; } || true

SessionStart._comment: CRG graph status on session open
